description: Header file defining the VDSOSupport class for kernel VDSO symbol lookup and related utilities within the Abseil debugging internal namespace.

classes.name: VDSOSupport
classes.description: Class providing kernel VDSO support, symbol lookup, and CPU identification.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to start of VDSO symbols.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of VDSO symbols.

methods.name: LookupSymbol
methods.description: Looks up a versioned dynamic symbol in the VDSO.

methods.name: LookupSymbolByAddress
methods.description: Finds symbol info overlapping a given address.

methods.name: SetBase
methods.description: Replaces the real VDSO base with a mock for testing.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes and returns the VDSO base address.
